name: Oak Knoll District
also: Oak Knoll District of Napa Valley

known.article: Oak Knoll District of Napa Valley AVA
known.via: English Wikipedia "Oak Knoll District of Napa Valley AVA"

terms: American Viticultural Area. A wine labeled with one must take at least 85% of its grapes from that area.

notes: Napa is known above all for Cabernet Sauvignon, with strong black fruit flavors.
Napa Chardonnay is often associated with pineapple notes.
Napa Zinfandel is plummy and intense, with red berry, cedar and vanilla, often in a claret style.

blurb.text: A Napa Valley AVA at the southern end of the valley, near San Pablo Bay, whose maritime influence makes it one of the coolest parts of Napa outside Carneros.
